# Claim Analysis Engine - AI Context Map

## Project Summary
A hybrid intelligence platform for food safety quality control that combines real-time operational monitoring with ML-powered risk prediction. The system tracks manufacturing defects via LOT analysis, detects anomalies using statistical process control (Nelson Rules, CUSUM), and generates 4-month ensemble forecasts using Prophet, LightGBM, and SARIMAX models. Built for Korean food manufacturers to enable early warning systems and data-driven resource allocation.

## File Map

### Core Application
- app.py - Main Streamlit dashboard (Quality Control Tower); real-time risk monitoring with drill-down navigation
- requirements.txt - Python dependencies (Streamlit, PyArrow, CatBoost, PyTorch, Optuna, Statsmodels)

### Business Logic (core/)
- core/config.py - System constants (54-field schema, thresholds, color codes)
- core/storage.py - Parquet I/O layer; unified data loader with PyArrow Dataset lazy loading
- core/etl.py - CSV/Excel ingestion pipeline; 54-field validation and deduplication
- core/analytics.py - Risk scoring engine (Nelson Rules, CUSUM, sparse/dense detection logic)
- core/forecasting.py - Fast 4-month forecast for dashboard (Track A: lightweight ensemble)
- core/engine/models.py - ML model implementations (Prophet, SARIMAX, CatBoost, LSTM)
- core/engine/trainer.py - Deep simulation engine (Track B: model competition with Optuna)
- core/engine/allocator.py - Sub-category claim allocation logic with extinction detection

### UI Pages (pages/)
- pages/1_데이터_업로드.py - Data upload and ingestion interface
- pages/2_매출수량_관리.py - Sales volume management and tracking
- pages/3_플랜트_분석.py - Deep diagnostic analysis with pivot tables and risk scoring
- pages/4_예측_시뮬레이션.py - ML forecasting lab with model competition and allocation

### Data Storage (data/)
- data/hub/ - Parquet partitioned claims (year=YYYY/month=MM/*.parquet)
- data/sales/ - Sales volume data (Parquet format)
- data/models/ - Trained ML models (pickled)
- data/series/ - Time-series JSON snapshots for caching

### Documentation (docs/)
- docs/README.md - System overview and user guide
- docs/project_master.md - Technical master specification
- docs/copilot_instruction.md - AI assistant development guidelines
- docs/refactor_spec.md - Refactoring requirements and patterns
- docs/milestone.md - Development roadmap and milestones

### Testing & Utilities
- test_*.py - Pytest test suites (5 files: analytics, etl, forecasting, storage, trainer)
- scripts/ - Utility scripts for data ops and maintenance

## Tech Stack

### Languages & Runtime
- Python 3.10+ (UTF-8-sig encoding for Korean support)

### Web Framework
- Streamlit 1.31.1 (multi-page dashboard)
- Plotly (interactive visualizations)

### Data Processing
- Pandas 2.1.4 (data manipulation)
- PyArrow 14.0.1 (Parquet columnar storage with Hive partitioning)
- NumPy 1.24.3 (numerical computing)

### Machine Learning (Track B - Simulation)
- CatBoost 1.2.1 (gradient boosting)
- PyTorch 2.1.1 (LSTM deep learning)
- LightGBM (via AutoML)
- Optuna 3.14.0 (hyperparameter optimization)
- scikit-learn 1.3.2 (ML utilities)

### Statistics (Track A - Operational)
- Statsmodels 0.14.0 (SARIMAX time-series)
- SciPy (Poisson/Negative Binomial distributions)
- Prophet (Facebook's forecasting library)

### Development Tools
- pytest 7.4.3 (testing framework)
- black 23.12.1 (code formatting)
- flake8 6.1.0 (linting)

## Critical Constraints

### Data Schema
- System ONLY processes 54 fixed columns (TARGET_54_COLS in config.py)
- Primary key: 상담번호 (case number); deduplication keeps latest record
- Partitioning: Hive-style year=YYYY/month=MM/ for efficient time-range queries

### Filtering Modes
- 인입 (Inflow): 사업부문 in [식품, B2B식품] AND 불만원인 is not null
- 실적 (Performance): Same + 불만원인 in [제조불만, 구매불만, 고객불만족]
- Custom: User-selected business units and reasons

### Risk Thresholds
- Red (🔴): Score ≥ 80 (Danger)
- Yellow (🟡): Score ≥ 50 (Caution)
- Green (🟢): Score < 50 (Normal)

### Architecture Rules
- Track A (Operational): Lightweight ensemble (NumPy, Statsmodels ONLY)
- Track B (Simulation): Heavy ML allowed (CatBoost, PyTorch, Optuna)
- Single Source of Truth: All pages use core.storage.load_and_filter_data()
- Zero-filling: Missing months filled with 0 (not NaN) for trend detection
- Zero-trend guard: Recent 6 months all zero → predict 0 (no training)
